Not an issue (corrected): --rgb-primary-text-color is only defined in the light block, but apply_themes_on_element derives the --rgb-* triplet from each theme color at runtime, so dark mode gets 225,225,225. The kit sets the dark values of the six rgba() users (sidebar-icon-color, label-badge-text-color, mdc-checkbox/radio-unchecked-color, ha-assist-chip-filled-container-color, chip-background-color) accordingly.
wa.globals.ts: --wa-color-brand-border-normal maps to core --ha-color-primary-50 instead of a semantic border token
Semantic tokens reference legacy --white-color instead of --ha-color-white (text-primary dark, on-*-loud)
--state-unavailable-color and --state-icon-error-color fall back from variables (--state-icon-unavailable-color, --error-state-color) that are not defined in the theme files

Dialog widths (--ha-dialog-width-sm/md/lg/full) and --ha-dialog-max-height are documented as tokens on the contributor site but only exist as fallbacks in ha-dialog.ts; no theme file defines them. The kit holds them as Layout/dialog/width-* with the ha-dialog.ts defaults.

ha-form spacing (24px between fields, 4px between a field alert and its field) and the picker field minimum height (56px) are plain values in the source with no --ha-space token, as the docs state (token: None).
